reviewNotes.prod:
Budgeer is a personal finance app: expenses and income, monthly budgets, recurring payments with Plan (a place to try changes to them before making them), savings goals, a meal voucher card, salary insights, and splitting bills with friends in groups. It never holds or moves money, and it is free: no in-app purchases and no ads.

Sign in with the demo account below (email and password on the sign-in screen). It is an ordinary account made for review; add, edit and delete anything you like.

Two apps: Budgeer (com.budgeer.app) is the production app, on budgeer.com's server. Budgeer Dev (com.budgeer.app.dev) is the same app on our test server (dev.budgeer.com), used to test new versions before they reach Budgeer; its accounts are separate.

Notes:
- Sign-in: email and password, Sign in with Apple or Google.
- The camera is used only to read a receipt on the device (Apple's Vision); the photo is not saved or uploaded.
- Face ID is an optional app lock (More > Account & settings > Face ID lock).
- The AI helpers are optional and off until the user turns them on (More > Account & settings > AI helpers).
- Account deletion: More > Account & settings > Security > Delete account.
- Privacy policy: https://www.budgeer.com/privacy. Support: support@budgeer.com.
